notes.title: A Wake Inn Update# 2.0
notes.content:
[u]Update #2.0 Changelist:[/u]

- Added 'Finger tracking' for Oculus Touch and Valve Index
- Fixed problem with accidental wheelchair movement while reaching lower drawers
- Doctor Finnegan now comments more places in the hotel
- Added joystick/joypad turning 
- Added joystick step rotation turning
- Improved inventory menagement 
- Added Swap Tool additional button (B on Valve Index and B and Y on Oculus Touch)
- Changed default bindings for Valve Index (Interaction is now under Trigger and Specific actions are now under Grip)

notes.title: A Wake Inn localizations
notes.content:
Today we'd like to tell you our plans for A Wake Inn's localizations and language support. 

Below you can find the list of languages which we plan to implement to our game (listed alphabetically): 

Chinese 
French 
German 
Italian 
Japanese 
Korean 
Polish 
Portuguese 
Russian 
Spanish 

In basic local language versions, we will add subtitles for the dialogues. 
In further updates, we will translate the UI and UX content. New language versions will be added after the release.  Once A Wake Inn is out, keep checking our Steam page and social media channels - we will inform you about the progress there. 

All the best and we will see each other soon!

notes.title: 'A Wake Inn Insights' part 3
notes.content:
Hello Wakeling,

Once again I have an episode of 'A Wake Inn: Insights' series waiting for you! 

In this video, I will show you how you'll meet the strange beings lurking in the dark corners of the Silver Inn Hotel. 
Mannequins, dolls, puppets - no matter what you call them, they're equally dangerous. 

Learn more about your enemy in the video down below:

[previewyoutube=v8LZd1M6VZM;full][/previewyoutube]

On February 25th (7 p.m. CET) you will be able to enter my world!

Good luck,
Dr. Finnegan
